! bolero work use foo bar baz

stderr '^bolero: foo is not a directory'
stderr '^bolero: directory baz does not exist'
cmp go.work go.work_want

! bolero work use -r qux
stderr '^bolero: qux is not a directory'

-- go.work --
go 1.18
-- go.work_want --
go 1.18
-- foo --
-- qux --
-- bar/go.mod --
module bar
